connector.name: AgentSEO
connector.registryDescription: Live SEO workflow tools for Claude Code, Codex, and AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at agentseo.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.agentseo.www. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
